title: Workload Trajectory Optimizer and Safe Batch-Param Autopilot
creator: Lena Zhang
description: Goal: Build an automated engine that profiles workload "trajectory" (short-term drift + long-term trends) and synthesizes continuous batching/caching parameter updates with conservative safety controls and an automated rollback path. Scope: workload vectorization (sequence length dist, arrival burstiness, token-per-request histograms, KV-hit traces), lightweight forecasting (exponential smoothing + changepoint detection), a hill-climbing optimizer that proposes parameter deltas (micro-batch size, coalescing window, KV cache TTL, prefix caching thresholds), and an apply pipeline that enforces shadow validation, phased canaries, metric-based roll forward or rollback. Deliverables: (1) backend service for trajectory profiles and proposals, (2) safe-apply orchestration integrated with rollout system (canary percentages + automated rollback), (3) telemetry dashboards and an "autopsy" record for each apply to feed the continuous learner.
acceptance_criteria: Engine produces workload trajectory profile for a target model and route within 10s of profile query
Proposal lists concrete parameter deltas (batch size, coalesce_ms, kv_ttl_ms, cache_key_strategy) and estimated cost delta with confidence band
Shadow-run validation can be executed automatically for a proposed config and produces latency, cost, and quality deltas vs baseline
Phased rollout automation can ramp a config from 0% -> 1% -> 5% -> 25% -> 100% with automated rollback triggers based on P99 latency, error rate, or quality regression thresholds
Autopsy artifacts (input profile, proposal, shadow metrics, rollout timeline, rollback reason) are persisted and queryable from Console for 90 days
tasks: Design workload vector schema and storage (time-windowed samples) -- doc linked
Implement lightweight forecasting component (changepoint + exponentially-weighted forecast)
Build optimizer to translate forecasted workload to parameter proposals with cost/risk scoring
Integrate shadow-run harness to run proposed configs against mirrored traffic and collect deltas

notes: Key heuristics: (1) weight proposals by expected cost reduction vs SLO risk using a tunable risk_budget per-customer-route, (2) prefer cache parameter changes (kv_ttl, prefix_cache) when forecasted session reuse > threshold, (3) prefer coalescing-window reductions only when burstiness metric shows >60% of arrivals within 2x median inter-arrival window, (4) conservative default proposals limited to <= 15% change in per-token throughput to bound tail effects.
rollout_plan: 1) Shadow-run for 48h on mirrored traffic; collect P50/P95/P99, error-rate, quality-eval, cost per token. 2) Canary phased ramp: 1% (6h) -> 5% (12h) -> 25% (24h) -> 100% (48h) with health checks at each step. 3) Automatic rollback triggers: P99 latency increase >20% vs baseline for >15 minutes, error-rate increase >1% absolute, eval-quality regression >1% absolute, or cost increase >5% for >30 minutes. 4) If rollback, capture autopsy and mark proposal with failure tags for future learner retraining.
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: optimizer proposes aggressive coalescing that degrades tail latency during infrequent bursts. Mitigation: require shadow-run that samples rare burst windows; implement throttled apply that caps concurrent batch growth; expose per-route opt-out and manual approval flow.
